LanguageData.OOCMSB.Title: Out Of Combat Move Speed Boost
LanguageData.OOCMSB.NonCombatSpeedMult.Label: Non-Combat Speed Multiplier
LanguageData.OOCMSB.NonCombatSpeedMult.TT: All pawns movement speed will be multiplied by this when there are no threats detected on any map. Includes animals.
LanguageData.OOCMSB.ShowBoostToggle.Label: Show Speed Boost Toggle
LanguageData.OOCMSB.ShowBoostToggle.TT: When active there will be a speed boost toggle button in the widget bar on the bottom right of the screen.
LanguageData.OOCMSB.ManualReactivation.Label: Manual Reactivation
LanguageData.OOCMSB.ManualReactivation.TT: When the speed boost is automatically cancelled it will remain toggled off until it is manually reactivated.
LanguageData.OOCMSB.DraftedDisable.Label: Disable When Drafted
LanguageData.OOCMSB.DraftedDisable.TT: The boost will automatically cancel itself when any of your pawns are drafted, and resume a few seconds after there are no threats on the map and all of your pawns have been undrafted.
LanguageData.OOCMSB.OnOffNotification.Label: Enable Notification
LanguageData.OOCMSB.OnOffNotification.TT: When enabled will notify you when the effect gets disabled and re-enabled.
LanguageData.OOCMSB.BoostToggle.Tooltip: Toggle out of combat speed boost. \n\nWhen there are no threats on any active map all pawns will move {0} times faster.
